描述_EN: eg.cpt.223 a: this fragment comprises a large part of the upper half of the original square. eg.cpt.223 b: this piece of tapestry comes from the right-hand side of the square's border. the highly stylized figure is probably a nereid seated on a fabulous aquatic animal. A small part of two medallions remain, but their iconography is no longer legible, as well as a fine frieze forming a final border is formed by the repetition of small outward-pointing triangles. il is composed of the remains of a framing border decorated with plants, animals and an offering-bearing putto inscribed in medallions, and the central scene enclosed within a circle, a large part of which remains. two fragments belonging to the same tapestry square are listed under inventory no. eg.cpt.223.
描述_ZN: eg.cpt.223 a: 这块碎片包括原广场上半部分的一大部分。 eg.cpt.223 b: 这块挂毯来自广场边框的右侧。 高度风格化的人物可能是一个坐在神话般的水生动物上的Nereid。 两个奖章的一小部分被保留下来，但它们的图案已无法辨认，还有一个形成最后边界的精美门楣，是由重复的小的外向三角形形成的。 年，它由一个边框的遗迹组成，边框上装饰着植物、动物和一个带着铭文的祭品的普陀，中心场景被围在一个圆圈中，其中很大一部分被保存下来。 属于同一挂毯广场的两块碎片被列在库存号eg.cpt.223下。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
